query: SELECT p.id, p.name, COUNT(pq.quickQuantityId) as qty_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN productQuickQuantities pq ON p.id = pq.productId GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING qty_count > 0 LIMIT 5
